tag.name: API Keys
tag.description: Create, list, and revoke external API keys for programmatic access.

get.description:
**Required scope:** `admin:credentials`

List this tenant's active (non-revoked) API keys, newest first. Owner-only: callers whose tenant membership role is not `owner` receive `403`. The plaintext key value is NEVER returned by this endpoint — only the `key_prefix` (a short non-secret identifier) is included. The full secret is shown exactly once, at creation time. The result is capped at 200 rows.

post.description:
**Required scope:** `admin:credentials`

Create a new external API key for this tenant. Owner-only: callers whose tenant membership role is not `owner` receive `403`. Granting admin-tier scopes (`admin:tenant`, `admin:billing`, `admin:credentials`) is restricted to owners; a non-owner requesting any admin scope is rejected with `403`. If `expires_at` is supplied it must be an ISO 8601 datetime in the future, otherwise `400` is returned. Issuance is rate-limited per actor and per tenant; exceeding either limit returns `429` with a `Retry-After` header.

The response contains the plaintext key in the `key` field. This is the ONLY time the full secret is ever returned — it is hashed at rest and cannot be retrieved again. Store it securely on receipt.

201.description: The created API key, including the plaintext `key` shown only once.

parameters.name: keyId
parameters.description: Id of the API key to revoke.

delete.description:
**Required scope:** `admin:credentials`

Revoke (permanently disable) an API key by id. Owner-only: callers whose tenant membership role is not `owner` receive `403`. The `keyId` must be a valid UUID, otherwise `400` is returned. Returns `204 No Content` on success. If no matching active key is found for this tenant — wrong tenant, unknown id, or already revoked — the endpoint returns `404`. Revocation is irreversible.

204.description: The API key was revoked. No response body.

ApiKeyScope.description: A scope grant from the Zoop scope catalog.

ApiKeyRow.description: A surfaced API key row. The `actor_kind` discriminator correlates with `user_id`: `user` keys carry the issuing user's uuid; `tenant` (service-principal) keys carry `null`. The plaintext key is never included — only the non-secret `key_prefix`.

ApiKeyRowUser.description: A user-actor API key. Acts as the issuing user; `user_id` is that user's id.

id.description: Unique id of the API key.

key_prefix.description: Non-secret short prefix of the key, safe to display.

expires_at.description: Expiry timestamp, or null if the key never expires.

last_used_at.description: Timestamp of the key's last use, or null if never used.

created_by.description: Id of the admin user who issued the key.

user_id.description: Id of the user this key acts as.

ApiKeyRowTenant.description: A tenant-actor (service-principal) API key. Belongs to the tenant; `user_id` is always null.

id.description: Unique id of the API key.

key_prefix.description: Non-secret short prefix of the key, safe to display.

expires_at.description: Expiry timestamp, or null if the key never expires.

last_used_at.description: Timestamp of the key's last use, or null if never used.

created_by.description: Id of the admin user who issued the key.

user_id.description: Always null for tenant keys (no acting user).

ApiKeyCreate.description: Request body for creating an API key.

name.description: Human-readable label. Trimmed server-side; must be non-blank (1-100 chars) after trimming.

scopes.description: Scopes to grant. Admin-tier scopes (`admin:*`) require owner role. Defaults to an empty array if omitted.

actor_kind.description: Whether the key acts as the issuing user (`user`) or as the tenant service principal (`tenant`).

expires_at.description: Optional ISO 8601 expiry. Must be in the future. Omit for a key that never expires.

ApiKeyCreateResponse.description: Response from creating an API key. The `key` field carries the plaintext secret and is returned ONLY here, exactly once — it cannot be retrieved again.

id.description: Id of the newly created key.

key.description: The plaintext API key secret. Shown exactly once; store it securely now.

prefix.description: Non-secret short prefix of the key, safe to display and matches `key_prefix` on the row.

row.description: The full surfaced row for the created key. Omitted if the post-issue re-fetch failed (the key still works; refresh the list to reconcile).
